item.tib: tshe chog 'chi med gter bum gyi las mtha' bla bslu 'chi bslu'i lag len srog gi chad mthud
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang rang gi gcung po skam zhig rnam rgyal tshul khrims nas 'di ltar dgos zhes bskul ngor/ sgo rigs kyi drang srong mkhan ming nyi ri shel zhin gyis g.yas ru mkhar sna'i gsang phug tu sbyar bas dge 'gyur cig/
